question: What SCF RFPs are open right now — what is the SCF asking builders to build this quarter?

golden.answer:
A grounded answer checks the official SCF RFP Track page and live Scout response, and dates each roster. As of 2026-11-05, the official RFP Track page lists no open brief and says "October 2026: New Q4 RFPs are coming soon." Scout now agrees: open=0, activeQuarter=q4-2026, both former Q3 briefs closed. Its separate synthetic scf-round-46 row describes the Submission window through 2026-11-09; it is not an RFP brief. A 2026-10-16 handbook edit withdrew the two Q3 briefs, LayerZero DVN and x402 Facilitator with Bazaar.

The dated example is illustrative. A later answer must report the roster and round state supported then.
